intuition: Encryption is deterministic, while decryption may have several preimages, so the fixed dictionary can be summarized by encrypted-word counts.

brute_force.approach: For each decrypt request, enumerate every character mapping combination and check generated words against the dictionary.

optimal.approach: Map plaintext characters to codes and pre-encrypt every dictionary word into a frequency table.
optimal.time: construction O(DL), encrypt O(L), decrypt O(C)

edge_cases: Encryption returns an empty string if any plaintext character has no mapping.
Multiple dictionary words may produce the same ciphertext.
